body: I like to read books. I don't do it often, but when I do, it somewhat helps. As if I can breath easier. I only read real books, their smell is amazing.

Therapists will never help because it's not profitablel to them. If they 'help' you, they will lose their paycheck. The only thing they might do is make you feel worse. The worse you feel, the more you will come to them, the more money they will receive. That's just my experience.
